textRuns.value: Shares are summed before they are divided, so a run's subdivisions carry their real weight. Averaging the per-scope percentages would count a small archive the same as a large one. Names with no rows are registered in the writer and have never been written; the registry table is what makes that visible, since a query over recorded metrics alone cannot show a metric that was never recorded.

Trends read one metric at a time. Select a row in the coverage matrix to filter both charts. A metric written by several stages of one notebook shares a timestamp across them, so the lines are separated by stage rather than summed into one.
